policy: B (forced-rerun sensitivity analysis), pre-registered before any official Stage 2 generation
decided_by: Rohan Sainju (rosai2@morgan.edu), explicit message in the Claude Code session
recorded_before: any official Stage 2 generation on any host (no local/runs/stage2-<host>/ directory exists at commit time)
supersedes: config_stage2.json -> forced_rerun_policy (candidates A/B). That field is left unchanged because config_stage2.json is hashed in the frozen records (local freeze stage2_freeze_local-rtx4060.json, SHA-256 27e3930942e9d895c19c77789625c292b0ff275728f54c2d9b3a178f06f0ccf1); this file is the binding rule for every Stage 2 model and host.
rules: The official Stage 2 score is always the original 16,384 + 2,048 run. The rerun never replaces, merges into or changes it.
After a model's Stage 2 generation is complete, identify its forced items (definition below).
For each model, select a fixed random sample of up to 20 forced items with the documented seed (algorithm below).
If a model has 20 or fewer forced items, rerun all of them.
Rerun the selected items at a 24,576-token reasoning budget with everything else unchanged.
The rerun is sensitivity analysis only.
Selection never uses whether the original answer was right or wrong: it reads only item_id and the forced flag; no answer key, score or status is consulted.
forced_item_definition: In local/runs/stage2-<host>/attempts_<model>.jsonl, the item's record with final_attempt == true contains the budget message marker 'Time is up. I must stop thinking now' (score_local.py FORCE_MARK) in reasoning_text, i.e. the reasoning reached the 16,384-token limit and the server forced the conclusion. This includes forced items whose answer then exceeded the 2,048-token allowance.
selection_algorithm:
ids = sorted(forced item_ids)  # lexicographic
selected = ids if len(ids) <= 20 else sorted(random.Random(f"20261005|stage2|forced-rerun|{model}").sample(ids, 20))  # Python 3 random module

rerun_settings.unchanged: model, GGUF, template, chat_template_kwargs, sampling, per-item seed, rendered prompt, budget message and server forcing, answer-allowance enforcement, infrastructure-rerun rule, host
rerun_settings.necessary_consequences: n_ctx recomputed with the same n_ctx_rule for the larger max_tokens, and placement re-measured with the same approved placement rule if the larger context requires it; both recorded with the rerun

outputs: a separate directory per host (local/runs/stage2-forced-rerun-<host>/), never local/runs/stage2-<host>/
timing: Reruns begin only after the user approves them; none is started automatically.
